set.body:
Scope

Add S06, S08, S09, S13 extension, and S18 as public acceptance scenarios.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] S06 covers a factor plus continuous modulator under grand/within-cell centering, per-cell/shared slopes, missing-value policies, and audit receipts.
- [ ] S08 covers a fully crossed 3x3 design with stable level ordering, unequal ordinal scores, linear/quadratic trends, interaction trends, and omnibus tests.
- [ ] S09 assigns canonical, informed, and FIR bases to different structural cells with heterogeneous widths and no manual offsets.
- [ ] S13 distinguishes shared, run-specific, and separate/fixed-effects models over mixed acquisition grids and validates cross-run hypotheses.
- [ ] S18 proves WLS against square-root-weighted OLS and an independent external/direct reference.
- [ ] Scenario generation does not use the compiler under test to create end-to-end truth unless explicitly labelled a solver-only test.
- [ ] Each scenario asserts structural columns, policies/audit, numerical results, and provenance.
- [ ] No raw design matrix or numeric contrast bookkeeping appears on the public workflow path.
- [ ] Manifest entries identify the exact reference layer and include reproducible receipts.
- [ ] All scenarios return clean Pass and run on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: P2.7: activate policy, heterogeneous-HRF, multirun, and WLS scenarios
